report.title: Dependency confusion and registry index poisoning against the resolver
report.question: If a public registry offers a package with the same name (or a higher version) as a private/internal one, which does the resolver choose - and can an index entry be added or altered without detection?
report.headline_answer: SPLIT BY LAYER, decided by payload_digest and machine gate code. Resolver CHOOSES the shadow (version-only, publisher-blind). load_index/resolve accept an unsigned tampered hash or manifest_path. Gated Installer DEFEATS both end-to-end: MKT-I02 on the shadow, MKT-I01 on unsigned edits, MKT-I03 on a re-signed digest edit. Fetched attacker hash: none.
